inv.location: Calle de Rodríguez San Pedro, Gaztambide, Chamberí, Madrid
features: 2 toilets or bathrooms adapted for the disabled
inv.desc_es:
Traspaso Restaurante en Chamberí.

Restaurante listo para continuar actividad, a 400 m del intercambiador de Moncloa, licencia definitiva de Restaurante con horario de 10:00h a 2:000h y viernes, sábado, domingo y vísperas 1/2 hora más, aforo 31 personas, opcionalmente se pueden poner dos mesas altas en la terraza. El local dispone de oficina.

El local se distribuye en salón de 38,47 m2 con una gran barra y baño discapacitados. Tenemos una amplia cocina de 18,96 m2 con salida de humos, fuegos, amasadora, horno pizzas, lavavajillas, neveras positivo y negativo, horno, cámara de 1,74 m2, etc.

Condiciones:
Alquiler 1.800€ + IVA - IRPF
2 meses fianza 
Traspaso 75.000€.
inv.desc_en:
Restaurant for lease transfer in Chamberí.

Restaurant ready to continue operations, 400m from the Moncloa transport hub, permanent restaurant license with operating hours from 10:00 AM to 2:00 AM, and an additional half hour on Fridays, Saturdays, Sundays, and eves of public holidays. Capacity for 31 people; two high tables can optionally be placed on the terrace. The premises include an office.

The space is distributed into a 38.47 m2 dining area with a large bar and a restroom for people with disabilities. We have a spacious 18.96 m2 kitchen with a smoke vent, burners, dough mixer, pizza oven, dishwasher, positive and negative refrigerators, oven, 1.74 m2 walk-in cooler, etc.

Conditions:
Rent €1,800 + VAT - Personal Income Tax (IRPF)
2 months deposit
Transfer fee €75,000.
inv.title_en: Restaurant for transfer in Calle de Rodríguez San Pedro
